description: This source file defines the CurlMultiHandler class, which is part of the GuzzleHttp library. It manages asynchronous HTTP requests using cURL's multi interface, providing methods to initialize, handle, and execute multiple concurrent cURL requests with support for delays, cancellation, and message processing.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Handles concurrent HTTP requests asynchronously using cURL's multi interface. Manages request handles, delays, options, and message processing to facilitate non-blocking HTTP communication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with optional configuration, sets up the factory, select timeout, and curl options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the curl multi handle resource, applying configured options.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the curl multi handle resource upon object destruction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes a request asynchronously, returning a promise that resolves when the request completes.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs a single tick of the curl event loop, processing messages, adding delayed handles, and handling select events.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the event loop until all requests have completed.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a request handle to the queue, with optional delay.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing request handle, removing it from the multi handle and closing it.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Handles completed curl messages, resolving corresponding promises.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next scheduled delay handle.
